description: Search Frontier's evidence-scored index of new research from the top scientific journals. Matches the query against titles, plain-language summaries, authors and topics, optionally within one field, and returns the matching entries ranked by Frontier Score (or newest paper first), each with its summary, score, Frontier URL and DOI. Leave the query empty to browse a field.

limit.description: How many entries to return (1 to 20).

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'CRISPR', 'obesity drug', 'quantum error correction'.

sort.description: 'score' ranks by Frontier Score; 'newest' by paper publication date.

name: search_breakthroughs
title: Search scored breakthroughs
